body.p: Claims 2-21 are pending in the application. Sixteen claims have been canceled, two claims have been amended, and no claims have been added.
Claims 2-12 and 14-21 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 102(a)(1) as being anticipated by U.S. Patent Publication No. 2008/0167821 to Breed.
Claims 2-12 and 14-21 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 102(a)(2) as being anticipated by Breed.
By this paper, rejected claims 1-10 and 17-21 have been canceled. The matter of

allowable claim 13, and it intervening claim 12, have been added to claim 11, rendering claim 11 allowable. Claim 14 was adjusted as to dependency. Claims 14-16 are submitted to be allowable due to their dependency. Claims 12 and 13 were canceled as redundant.
Claim 13 is objected to as being dependent upon a rejected base claim, but would be
allowable if rewritten in independent form including all of the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims.
By this paper, the matter of claim 13 was added to claim 11, and claim 13 was canceled.

Applicant submits that all pending claims are now in condition for allowance, an indication of which is respectfully solicited. Should the Examiner be of the view that an interview would expedite consideration of the application, request is made that the Examiner telephone co- inventor, Kemp Massengill at (760) 390-1410 in order that any outstanding issues be resolved.
Applicant submits that all pending claims are now in condition for allowance, an indication of which is respectfully solicited.
